Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team at HealthBridge is excited about Redwood’s private VPC offering. Security kicked off a quick gating checklist and there are two blockers we need to clear to move forward with a full POC:

- We need an additional trial allocation specifically for a private/VPC environment so security can run their automated scans and ingest logs for one week (they want an isolated environment).
- They requested a short SOC2 evidence checklist that maps what artifacts Redwood can provide during the evaluation (audit logs, retention windows, encryption details).

We’ve attached a short checklist (SOC2-evidence-request.pdf). Ideally we’d get a top-up for 30k tokens or equivalent trial credits and an extension of the trial window by 14 days. We understand this is promotional/exceptional — happy to sign a simple MSA addendum or mutual action plan that limits use to the POC and prevents production data.

Timeline: security would like to start scans on 2026-10-19 and run them for ~5 working days. Can you let me know what you need from our side to make the top-up possible?

Thanks,
Aisha Varma
Director, Product Security
HealthBridge, Inc.

Marcus/Priyom/Laura — thanks for the quick reply. Answers below:

1) Token estimate: security will run scripted scans that will ingest ~18k tokens over 5 days; add a buffer for retries, so 30k total is our ask.
2) Data types: the POC will use synthetic data and redacted samples — no live PHI or customer-identifiable data will be used. We will provide a short attestation if that helps.
3) Paperwork: HealthBridge is comfortable with a short POC addendum that restricts the top-up use to security scans and test traffic only — we can sign within 48 hours.

I’ve attached a draft SOW for the POC (healthbridge-sow-draft.docx) that includes objectives and timeline (start 2026-10-19). Let me know if that covers what you need.

Best,
Aisha
